warnings.title: Armed R4 upgrade-preview card (variable height, right-anchored at win_w, drawn after the rail) extends below NOC_CONTENT_Y and covers the rail's header/DROPS rows

warnings.detail: The placement rationale cleared only health (74) + forecast (~104 at 1 row — shipped data caps forecasts at 1 row/era). With preview_active + D the card covers rail content rows 0..~11 — exactly the crisis moment an ops player opens the rail. Note: acceptance's 'longer forecasts' sub-claim was rejected (data caps at 1 row); the preview-card angle is the confirmed defect.

warnings.title: NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE is a dead constant — the 'tunable panel-width scale' does not derive NOC_PANEL_W
warnings.evidence:
NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE :: 1.4            // the panel-width scale (the ruling)
NOC_PANEL_W       :: 360 * 14 / 10 // 504 (= 360 × NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE, exact int math)
warnings.detail: Flipping NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE changes nothing — the width derives from a magic 14/10. Hard rule 2 ('the ladder is a tunable triplet + panel-width scale') is half-honored: the value (504) is right and documented, but the tunable contract is cosmetic. Reviewer agreement ×3.
warnings.recommended_fix: Derive NOC_PANEL_W from NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE via a comptime-legal int expression (e.g. 360 * i32(NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE*10) / 10) or a build-check test asserting 360*NOC_PANEL_W_SCALE rounds to NOC_PANEL_W.

warnings.title: Harness overlay verbs set the rail but never re-derive scale/off_x — the D-on harness captures render the world at the full-window fit, extending under the rail
warnings.evidence:
render_setup: rnd.view_compute(&rc.view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)  // ONE time, win_w-centered (view.odin:421-423 centers off_x on win_w)
overlay_check: rnd.view_set_rail(&rc.view, true)  // play_w only — scale/off_x untouched; no camera_update in the verb
warnings.detail: The code comment claims 'the world fits LEFT of the rail' in the harness frame — false: the world renders [160,1120] under the plate. App frame ≠ harness frame; the PR's 'world's right edge at x=755' matches the app (camera_update re-derives), not this path. overlay-pixels diff stays valid (both frames share the stale camera).
warnings.recommended_fix: After view_set_rail in the verbs, re-derive rc.view.scale = camera_fit(&rc.view) and off_x = play_w/2 − world center (mirror camera_update), so harness captures match the app.

warnings.title: Fit-to-rail wiring unpinned at the app layer: no test asserts play_w after the D-toggle, the resize re-apply, or the settings dismissal
warnings.evidence: grep play_w app/*_test.odin → only noc_overlay_test (render-layer View{} tests); pullback_test/noc_toggle_test assert overlay_on flips but never play_w.
warnings.detail: The render-layer fit IS pinned (camera_fit_respects_the_rail); the app-layer wiring — including the exact path where B1 shipped — has zero coverage. Corrected from the lens's overstated 'no camera test runs with the rail on'.
warnings.recommended_fix: App-layer pins: effect_overlay D-on → play_w == win_w−NOC_RAIL_W; D-off and settings-dismissal → play_w == win_w; resize while on → rail re-applied.

warnings.title: HUD re-anchoring on play_w has zero automated coverage (settings modal rect, audio caption, mode label/nudge)
warnings.evidence: grep settings_panel_rect app/*_test.odin → no matches; caption/label anchors are draw-time with no helper tests.
warnings.detail: settings_panel_rect is a pure helper exactly like the tested crisis_card_width — testable, untested. The re-anchor regime (which surfaces follow play_w) is contract-critical now that two anchor regimes coexist (see W1).
warnings.recommended_fix: Pin settings_panel_rect centering at play_w=win_w and play_w=win_w−NOC_RAIL_W; one helper-level test per re-anchored surface.

warnings.title: Per-class column math for 18px numerals is untested (del/drop/loss/SLA/rate right edges)
warnings.evidence: del_r := name_x + 196; drop_r := del_r + 84; loss_r := drop_r + 84; sla_x := loss_r + 16; rate_r := px + NOC_PANEL_W - 6 — no test references.
warnings.detail: The briefing's '7-digit counters fit at 18px' arithmetic (84px pitch = 76px digits + 8 breathing; name clearance 120px vs max 97px name) checks out by hand but is unpinned — a future ladder tweak can silently re-break it.
warnings.recommended_fix: One test pinning the column pitch ≥ 7-digit width at NOC_SIZE_BODY and name-zone clearance ≥ longest shipped class name.
